description: This file defines the HealthClient class within the Aws\Health namespace, extending the AwsClient class, and provides method annotations for interacting with AWS Health APIs and Notifications service.

classes.name: HealthClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Health APIs and Notifications service, providing methods to describe and manage health events and affected accounts/entities.

methods.name: describeAffectedAccountsForOrganization
methods.description: Fetches the list of affected accounts for an organization.

methods.name: describeAffectedAccountsForOrganizationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the list of affected accounts for an organization.

methods.name: describeAffectedEntities
methods.description: Retrieves affected entities related to health events.

methods.name: describeAffectedEntitiesForOrganization
methods.description: Fetches affected entities for an organization.

methods.name: describeAffectedEntitiesForOrganizationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches affected entities for an organization.

methods.name: describeEntityAggregatesForOrganization
methods.description: Provides entity aggregates for an organization.

methods.name: describeEventDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific event.

methods.name: describeEventDetailsForOrganization
methods.description: Fetches event details for an organization.

methods.name: describeEventsForOrganization
methods.description: Fetches health events for an organization.

methods.name: describeHealthServiceStatusForOrganization
methods.description: Reports the status of the AWS Health service for an organization.

methods.name: disableHealthServiceAccessForOrganization
methods.description: Disables access to the AWS Health service for an organization.

methods.name: enableHealthServiceAccessForOrganization
methods.description: Enables access to the AWS Health service for an organization.
